title: Two representations of one current have a.e. equal vector densities 1_M θ ξ
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, n ∈ ℕ, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), and let R_1 = (M_1, θ_1, ξ_1) and R_2 = (M_2, θ_2, ξ_2) be integer multiplicity triples in U (IMRep U n) that both represent T (R_1.Represents T and R_2.Represents T). Then for H^n⌞(M_1 ∪ M_2)-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P (H^n = μHE[n]) the n-vectors 1_{M_1}(x)θ_1(x)ξ_1(x) and 1_{M_2}(x)θ_2(x)ξ_2(x) in MultiVector P n are equal.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R₁.Represents T → R₂.Represents T → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∪ R₂.carrier)), R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x = R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x
